description: Veloce's own smoke ROM for the devkitARM C VELOCE-RESULT/1 emitter (tests/roms-src/include/devkitarm/veloce_test.h, built on the vendored mgba.c). Exercises every vt_* call with fixed values and emits a deterministic transcript; the shared determinism selftest runs it twice and byte-diffs the result files. Not an upstream test -- Veloce's own source, so there is no golden gate.

golden_gate_reason: No upstream: this is Veloce's own new ROM source (docs/testing/VELOCE-RESULT.md's determinism-selftest fixture), not a rebuild of an existing binary. See PROVENANCE.md.
